title: Fables in one world of wizards (no rush - still refining, not public)
summary: Your Nov 16 answers: wizards for all; keep The Friendly Crystal; the unique voice should be the one who interviewed a wise wizard, not the napkin. Reworked: **The Wizard Who Asked First** (Ten People, One Idea) - eight wizards ask the Mirror of Answers; young Wren first interviews old Maud, who has watched the river sixty springs, then asks the Mirror to help her say it plainly; hers is the only scroll that mentions the beaver dam. **The Endless Scroll** (The Chat Is Not Your Memory) - the galaxy story moved: an archmage's enchanted scroll that keeps growing; "I'll send an owl shortly"; now he keeps one page of decisions. Full text in the file.
